learners_amount: 293 learners have completed this activity in the past 12 months.
star_rating: Average rating of 4.5 stars by 14 learners in the past 12 months.
description:
About this learning activity

Exploring Cybersecurity is designed to introduce you to the world of cybersecurity: what it is, what its principles are, and how it safeguards you from cyberattacks.

 

This module is appropriate for everyone: students, working professionals, job seekers, and anyone looking to expand their skills or transition into cybersecurity-related roles.

 

What you’ll learn

After completing this module, you should be able to:

  • Define cybersecurity
  • Identify the three principles of cybersecurity
  • Identify common types of cybersecurity
  • Determine strategies to protect systems and data from cyberattacks

 

Lessons

  1. Introduction to cybersecurity
  2. Digital threats
  3. Social engineering
  4. Physical threats
  5. The future of cybersecurity
  6. Cybersecurity and you!

title: City and Guilds: Cybersecurity
learners_amount: 157 learners have completed this activity in the past 12 months.
star_rating: Average rating of 4.5 stars by 7 learners in the past 12 months.
description: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting systems, networks, and programs from digital attacks. These cyberattacks typically aim to access, change, or destroy sensitive information, extort money from users, or interrupt normal business processes. Implementing effective cybersecurity measures is particularly challenging today because there are more devices than people, and attackers are becoming more innovative. A robust cybersecurity strategy includes multiple layers of protection spread across computers, networks, programs, and data. To create a successful defense, an organization needs to integrate people, processes, and technology, ensuring that sensitive data is secured from unauthorized access and potential cyber threats. Learn the basics, and dive into the cybersecurity world.
